rows.title: BEXIMCO: Board Meeting schedule under LR 19(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 19(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on October 28, 2024 at 4:30 PM to consider, among others, audited financial statements of the Company for the year ended June 30, 2024.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Price Limit Open
rows.body: There will be no price limit on the trading of the shares of the Company today (29.10.2024) following its corporate declaration. However, the floor price shall be applicable accordingly.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Dividend Declaration
rows.body: The Board of Directors has recommended 5% Stock Dividend for the year ended June 30, 2024. Date of AGM: 30.12.2024, Time: 10:30 AM, Venue: Hybrid System. Record Date: 25.11.2024. The Company has also reported EPS of Tk. (0.41), NAV per share of Tk. 92.58 and NOCFPS of Tk. (12.41) for the year ended June 30, 2024 as against Tk. 7.92, Tk. 95.14 and Tk. 3.42 respectively for the year ended June 30, 2023. Reasons for recommendation of Stock Dividend: (cont.)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Dividend Declaration
rows.body: (Cont. news of BEXIMCO): a) The retained amount of recommended stock dividend will be used to profitable investment or reinvestment in Company. b) Stock dividend is declared out of accumulated profit. c) Stock Dividend is not declared from capital reserve or valuation reserve or any unrealized gain or out of profit earned prior to incorporation of the Company or through reducing paid up capital or through doing anything so that the post-dividend retained earnings become negative or a debit balance. (end)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on November 13, 2024 at 5:00 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the First Quarter (Q1) period ended September 30, 2024.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Q1 Financials
rows.body: (Q1 Un-audited): EPS was Tk. (1.26) for July-September 2024 as against Tk. (0.79) for July-September 2023; NOCFPS was Tk. 10.96 July-September 2024 as against Tk. (2.69) for July-September 2023. NAV per share was Tk. 89.44 as on September 30, 2024 and Tk. 94.21 as on September 30, 2023.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Emphasis of Matter
rows.body: The auditor of the company has given the "Emphasis of Matter" paragraph in the audited financial statement of the company for the year ended June 30, 2024. To view the details please visit: https://www.dsebd.org/Auditors_opinion/2024/November/BEXIMCO_2024.pdf

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Spot News
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will be allowed only in the Spot Market and Block transaction will also be settled as per spot settlement cycle with cum benefit from 21.11.2024 to 24.11.2024 and trading of the shares will remain suspended on record date i.e., 25.11.2024.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Suspension for Record Date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will remain suspended on record date i.e., 25.11.2024.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Resumption after Record date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will resume on 26.11.2024.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Clarification on recent news regarding worker layoffs
rows.body: In response to a DSE query dated December 22, 2024 regarding clarification on recent news published in a national daily on December 19, 2024 regarding laying off of 40,000 workers at 15 apparel units, the company has informed DSE, among others, the following:"....Bangladesh Export Import Company Ltd. has been in operation and none of its units is laid off. 15 Apparel units mentioned in the news item were laid off are not concern of Bangladesh Export Import Company Ltd."

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Ordinary Shares of BEXIMCO credited against BEXGSUKUK
rows.body: The company has informed that a total 33,820 ordinary shares of Tk.10.00 each of Bangladesh Export Import Company Ltd. has been credited to the respective BO IDs of the 27 Nos. of Sukukholders who applied for conversion of their Sukuk holdings into ordinary shares of Bangladesh Export Import Company Limited.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Category Change
rows.body: The company will be placed in 'B' category from existing 'A' category with effect from January 01, 2025 as the company has approved 5% Stock Dividend for the year ended June 30, 2024.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Regarding nomination or appointment of Independent Directors
rows.body: Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) has appointed Independent Directors in the Board of the company. To view the information, please visit the following link: https://www.dsebd.org/Annexure/2024/BEXIMCO_BXPHARMA%20_SPCERAMICS_2025.pdf

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Dividend Disbursement
rows.body: The Company has informed that it has credited the Bonus Shares for the year ended June 30, 2024 to the respective shareholders' BO Accounts.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on January 28, 2025 at 5:00 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the Second Quarter (Q2) period ended December 31, 2024.

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Q2 Financials
rows.body: (Q2 Un-audited): EPS was Tk. (2.58) for October-December 2024 as against Tk. 0.82 for October-December 2023; EPS was Tk. (3.78) for July-December 2024 as against Tk. 0.03 for July-December 2023. NOCFPS was Tk. 12.58 for July-December 2024 as against Tk. 1.44 for July-December 2023. NAV per share was Tk. 82.57 as on December 31, 2024 and Tk. 93.98 as on December 31, 2023. (cont.)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Q2 Financials
rows.body: (Continuation news of BEXIMCO): During the period the production of the company was almost shut down due to non availability of Banking facilities. No Banks opened any LCs from August 2024, moreover, stocks of Fabrics & Yarns which could not be used had to be sold below cost price, as the Garments Factories were also shut down. This resulted in the company ending up with negative EPS as against corresponding previous period. (end)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Layoff Notice of Bangladesh Export Import Company Ltd.
rows.body: The company has attached a copy of the Layoff Notice dated 04.02.2025 issued by the Management of the company that declared Layoff of the Employees and Workers of Yarn Unit-2, Textile, Denim and Knitting Divisions located at Beximco Industrial Park, Saravo, Kashimpur, Gazipur of Bangladesh Export Import Company Ltd. (cont.)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Layoff Notice of Bangladesh Export Import Company Ltd.
rows.body: (Cont. news of BEXIMCO): The Company's other Divisions including Yarn Unit-I located at Taki, Tarabo, Rupganj will remain operational as usual. To view the Layoff Notice, please visit the following link: https://www.dsebd.org/Annexure/2025/Layoff%20Notice_BEXIMCO_2025.pdf (end)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Clarification on recent news published in newspaper
rows.body: In response to a DSE query letter to the company regarding a news published in a newspaper titled "Beximco Textiles: All factories closed, workers terminated" on February 27, 2025, the company has enclosed a copy of Notice issued to the Employees and Workers of the Company dated 26.02.2025. To view the Notice, please visit the following link: https://www.dsebd.org/Annexure/2025/Layoff%20and%20Operational%20Status_BEXIMCO_2025.pdf

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Clarification on recent news published in newspaper
rows.body: In response to a DSE query to the company regarding a news published in a newspaper titled "BEXIMCO defaults on 33 million euro loan in Germany (translated to English from Bengali)" on June 18, 2025, the company has submitted clarification vide its letter dated July 08, 2025. To view the letter, please visit the following link: https://www.dsebd.org/Annexure/2025/BEXIMCO-10-07-25.pdf

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Clarification on recent news published in newspaper
rows.body: (Cont. news of BEXIMCO): We hope that it will have positive financial impact on our organization. According to our projection, we will be able to earn a net profit of Tk 380 crore by December, 2026 providing factories resume operations by October, 2025." (end)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Clarification on recent news published in newspaper
rows.body: In response to a DSE query letter dated September 22, 2025, the company has informed the following: "...we would like to inform you that the mentioned news published in the website/online news portal https://www.prothomalo.com titled 'Investments from Japan and the United States are coming to launch 15 factories of BEXIMCO (translated from Bengali to English)' on 18th September, 2025 is authentic. (cont.)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Record Date for Conversion of Beximco Green-Sukuk Al Istisna'a
rows.body: Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB), the trustee of Bexico Green-Sukuk Al Istisna'a has informed that the Record Date for Conversion of Beximco Green-Sukuk Al Istisna'a was on 22 December, 2025. A total of 17 sukuk holders applied to convert 20% and 1 sukuk holder applied to convert 80% of their holding in Fourth Year. (cont.)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Record Date for Conversion of Beximco Green-Sukuk Al Istisna'a
rows.body: (Cont. News of BEXIMCO): Applicants had a total holding of 640 (Six Hundred Forty) sukuks in their name among which 350 (Three Hundred Fifty) sukuks were converted into 420 (Four Hundred Twenty) ordinary shares of Beximco Limited with a cost price of BDT 82.58. After the conversion process, the total remaining sukuk holding is 28,09,24,263 (Twenty Eight Crore Nine Lac Twenty Four Thousand Two Hundred Sixty Three). (end)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Ordinary Shares of BEXIMCO credited against BEXGSUKUK
rows.body: (Cont. News of BEXIMCO): to the respective BO IDs of the 18 Nos. of Sukukholders who applied for conversion of their Sukuk holdings into ordinary shares of Bangladesh Export Import Company PLC and as such after the allotment of the above shares the Paid-up Capital of the Company is stood at Tk. 943,23,62,620/-. (end)

rows.title: BEXIMCO: Ordinary Shares of BEXIMCO credited against BEXGSUKUK
rows.body: Refer to their earlier news disseminated by DSE on 23.12.2025 regarding Record Date for Conversion of Beximco Green-Sukuk Al Istisna'a, the issuer of Beximco Green-Sukuk Al Istisna'a has informed that a total 420 ordinary shares of Tk.10/- each of Bangladesh Export Import Company PLC has already been credited on 23rd December, 2025 (cont.)
